certificate.description: The Wind River FIPS Object Module is a general-purpose software cryptographic library offering symmetric encryption/decryption, digital signature generation/verification, hashing, cryptographic key generation, random number generation, message authentication, and key establishment functions. It is designed for ease of use with the popular OpenSSL cryptographic library and toolkit and is available for use as part of Wind River's platforms.
